d: Futuristic Science Fiction about a sport to the death, using destructocycles.
Two medieval knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused sorceress to a remote abbey.
A doctor (Justine Bateman) transplants the eyes of a wolf into a blind man (Cory Monteith).
Henry Spencer tries to survive his environment, his girlfriend, and the screams of his child.
Several years after a virus has ravaged the world, a soldier protects refugees from mutants.
Two opposing time travelers are sent back to the present to prevent a global biological disaster.
A marine biologist travels to Africa to investigate the unnatural behavior of sharks.
Gunslinger challenges desert outlaws who invaded a town created by survivors of civilization's fall.
Survivors (Dean Cain, Bettina Zimmermann) of a cataclysm search for a powerful device.
Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall.
A state-of-the-art fighter jet is humanity's last hope against flying reptilian creatures.
Detective (Joseph Bologna) and Cajun (Richard Lynch) track giant reptile.
A space ranger (Jesse Vint) lands at a research station where a flesh-eating mutant is loose.
Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009.
A policewoman and a biologist spring into action when sharks go on a deadly rampage in Lake Tahoe.

t: A Boy And His Dog [Broadcast Edit]
d: World War IV has ravaged Earth, and its survivors must battle for food, shelter and companionship.
Spiders mutate into giant monsters after an old Soviet space station crashes into New York City.
A chain of volcanic eruptions rips through Europe and plunges the continent into a new ice age.
A former psychic commits suicide after discovering animated, murderous puppets.
A family moves into a secluded mansion where they soon find themselves being targeted by an entity.
When a group of friends goes on a boat trip, a giant killer crocodile begins to pick them off.
Big steroid-mutated bugs attack troubled teens and their guides in the woods.
A Nobel Prize winner teams up with a Navy officer to find out the cause of disastrous tidal waves.
A seismologist and a miner must stop a massive earthquake that threatens to tear the world in half.
Adam and Eden fell in love as teens despite the fact that they live in opposite worlds.
A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats.
A family is separated during the convergence of three gigantic natural disasters.
With the help of an alien organism, a man brainwashes audiences through television.
Life on Earth is rapidly destroyed except for a small area in Eastern Europe.
